review.reviewBody:
[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] ordered a ring sizing kit as I was unsure what size I would require, and after trying them out i felt unsure between 8 & 9 so wore both for a full day & night on my index fingers....one felt a tad uncomfortable by morning & almost got stuck! Panic over; larger size ordered! 
When the ring arrived I was impressed by the premium packaging - black, sleek, sexy! The ring itself was in a clear plastic box which looked very sophisticated - this box is actually a charging dock for the ring. Very nice!
 Now onto the actual ring. It is nice to look at, not too bulky & feels comfortable to wear - in fact it is easy to forget you are even wearing this.
 It was incredibly easy to set up, ready to go in minutes. 
After day one I was excited to check my app to see what the Samsung Health app had to tell me. So the ring tracks steps, active minutes and calories burnt. It does so in a simple way by providing data in number form but also by showing your "rings" (on this app hearts, which is cute) and therefore allowing you to see if you are on target & if not then how close you are to closing those rings, I.e hitting targets. 
The ring tracks your sleep score & it does so in a completely non intrusive way as you really don't even notice you are wearing the ring, it really is in depth recording skincare temperature,  heart rate and even snoring. The app then gives explanations about the different stages of sleep & the importance of them before giving a breakdown of how long you were in each stage and whether or not this is sufficient. I learned that I don't get enough sleep & I certainly don't spend enough of that time in mental recovery...this explains a lot - the watch I was using previously was extremely unreliable when it came to sleep tracking. 
You can also track your workouts, I have connected Fit and Strava so it pulls the information over automatically for me which makes it seamless and effortless on my part. I do wish Centr fed directly into it rather then me having to piggyback that info via another app. Food tracking is also available. I've never really utilised something like this but thought Id try it out, it is a bit time consuming to add everything in but it was interesting to see the end result & honestly I can see how this would be helpful in my journey to a healthier lifestyle. Alongside food tracking you can also track water intake & set reminders to drink too.

A massive plus for ladies; it also tracks your cycle, predicting future periods and fertile windows, a feature I've not seen on any other wearable & one that is highly welcomed!

 Although it is early days and I still feel that I am discovering new benefits and features every day, i am very much enjoying this wearable & looking forward to a more detailed insight into my health! 

The only negative thing I can say right now is that  I'm disappointed that after just two days my ring is scratched, I would expect it to be more hard-wearing and durable to be honest. I was very torn between silver and black initially and this has made me wish that I had actually opted for the silver as perhaps it wouldn't have been noticeable on the silver version.
review.headline: Closing those rings - on your Samsung Ring!

review.reviewBody: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The ring is wonderful it keeps the health features continously connected and the readings consistently monitored and updated especially when paired with the watch 7 a great addition to phone and watch as the AI makes the connections seamlessly automatic between the s24 watch 7 and galaxy ring the battery life is phenomenally long maintaining continuity so sleeping with it on is no problem less worry about it dying and the comfort makes it seem as if I didn't notice I was wearing it and it looks great with other accessories bracelets rings watches etc......contently comfortable delightfully durable makes health regimen and exercise activities worth the extra push
review.headline: A fine addition to the family

review.reviewBody:
[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I am part of the Samsung eco system and I was looking to purchase the Ring soon as they announced it a few months back.  I have several health issues so wanting to monitor the stats accordingly to help assist me was a great idea in such a small device. 
I purchased the size 13 and when it arrived it was a joy to open.  The packaging was perfect, the ring in the sleek charging case is an awesome idea.
I find the stats track reasonably well especially at night. I find the ring to wear is comfortable and I tend to forget it's even there. 
My only negative is that I understand the device is not repairable and the ring is already showing signs of scuff marks.  
I hope the release the latest updates for gesture controls soon as I think that would be a great addition to test out.
review.headline: A few weeks later...

review.reviewBody: The long-story-short is, do not buy this ring, because it has one fatal flaw that renders it useless: battery life. I've had it for a little more than a year now, and for the first, say, 9 months, I loved this thing. It was comfortable, accurate, useful, durable. The app was excellent. But after a year... the battery capacity kept going down, down, down. Then it fell off a cliff. Now, after about 15 months, the ring doesn't hold a charge for more than a few hours. If I charge it before bed it's dead before I wake up. If you're willing to get a new ring each year, by all means order this. Otherwise, don't waste your money.
review.headline: Don't buy: you'll have to replace it within a year

review.reviewBody:
[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Samsung smart ring is absolutely amazing.  Something so small that can measure; heart rate, sleep, blood oxygen, mentrual cycles , workouts, energy score, oxygen levels, stress levels, works with other samsung AI devices.  Really enjoy the health AI features how it works together with my Samsung Fold 6, and samsung smart watch 7 AI features work together to compare & summarize your health results.   
    The ring stays charged for 5 days, and when ring needs to be charged it charges quickly in a neat looking smart case.  Which wireless charges too. This ring is so comfortable I forget that I am wearing it. I strongly recommend this ring when tracking your health.
review.headline: Best AI smart ring with the subscription fees

review.reviewBody: I was wanting a smart ring to keep track of my sleep and steps for when I wasn't wearing my watch. Luckily I looked up galaxy ring to see if samsung was releasing one and they were. I pre-ordered it and have had it ever since. I like how I can wear it 24/7 I only charge it 2 times a week and I love how all the stats are in the same app and that I can wear my watch and ring at the same time and things don't get counted twice. I am so happy that samsung has a ring so I don't have to have multiple apps. There was one point where the battery was dying very quickly, but I was sent a replacement and have been happy ever since.
review.headline: Exactly what I wanted

review.reviewBody: The ring in my experience is fairly accurate, it's comfortable and it serves the main purpose I wanted it for which is to act as a backup to my galaxy watch 7 and to be a more comfortable sleep monitor. I believe it does really well with sleep monitoring personally. I will however say that I have an S23 ultra and the ability to use gestures is not currently available with anything before the brand new galaxy phones at the time of writing this. That kinda sucks cause it feels like I can't use all of the product I spent a lot of money on. If you own other galaxy devices I think the ring is a good purchase if you do some research and really nail down why you want it.
review.headline: A good addition to my galaxy devices.

review.reviewBody: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I love Samsung products and technology and was researching the Galaxy ring for a while. I chose the Galaxy ring hoping for comfort and style however was not overly satisfied with the comfort. This may be personal, but in my opinion, if you have any "sensory" sensitivities this ring might not be the best for you, mostly do to it's size. Unfortunately I could not get used to the feeling, it did not feel natural and was too thick for my likeness. Although I chose the correct size per the samples provided, it just wasn't a comfortable fit for me. Thankfully I was able to return it, however had a return/restocking fee so wasn't reimbursed the full amount of my purchase.
review.headline: Not the best for "Sensory" sensitive people

review.reviewBody: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] As an owner of a samsung watch I am absolutely delighted with the samsung Ring. Sometimes I find that the watch bothers me a little specially with the heat. The ring does exactly what I want it to do, it tracks my sleep and heart without any weight making it much more comfortable to do so. It fits both my indicator finger and my thumb perfectly so can use accordingly to how I'm feeling or what I'm doing.  I personally like  not only it's functions and comfort but also it looks quite cool. Very satisfied
review.headline: Great addition to the samsung  universe

review.reviewBody: I was very pleased with my ring during the first several months of use. It performed well, and the battery life was excellent, lasting up to four days on a single charge. However, after about four months, the gold finish began to fade significantly.Now, at approximately 11 months of ownership, the battery life has declined dramatically. I currently need to charge the ring every 12 hours and often have to carry the charger with me throughout the day. This is a major disappointment considering how well it performed initially.While I appreciated the ring in the beginning, the decline in both appearance and battery performance within the first year has been frustrating
review.headline: Gold Samsung Ring

review.reviewBody: Generally, I am happy with the purchase. The stats that it provides (e.g., energy score and sleep scores) are intuitive, and I do use them to get insights into my health/wellness routine. I am not entirely sure whether the stress score is valid, or how to interpret it, since it changes drastically every time. Even though titanium is used as the base material, it does look a bit plasticky. Sometimes the ring would mislabel naps (e.g., if I watch TV). Other than that, it fits well, and I think it is a good alternative to watches, since it does not have a distracting screen and currently keeps a charge for around one week.
review.headline: Good alternative to SmartWatches

review.reviewBody:
[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The Galaxy Ring has been a seamless addition to my daily routine and my work in dental healthcare. It keeps me mindful of my health throughout long clinic days, tracking heart rate, sleep, and activity with impressive accuracy. Paired with Galaxy AI, I get clear, personalized insights instead of just raw data—perfect for planning busy surgery days.

I love how naturally it syncs with my Galaxy S25 Ultra, giving me quick health summaries and alerts without pulling out my phone. It’s sleek, comfortable, and feels more like a natural accessory than a gadget, yet it enhances both my professional focus and personal wellness.
review.headline: Galaxy Ring: Small but Incredibly Smart

review.reviewBody:
[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I am absolutely loving my Samsung Galaxy Ring! It's so easy to use and set up—I just connected it to the Samsung Health app, and I was ready to go.
What I appreciate most is having all my health data in one place. I can easily keep track of my steps, monitor my weight, and even set reminders for my medication. The period tracker has been incredibly accurate, which is a huge plus for me.
The only real issue I've run into is the battery life. I find myself having to charge it every other day, which can be a bit of a hassle. Despite that, the convenience and comprehensive tracking the ring offers make it totally worth it.
review.headline: Finally, a Smart Ring That Gets It Right

We bought this TV because of it being a 4K 144Hz matte screen with the Art mode. We love how bright or how dim we can make the image, and displaying our own photos. We also wanted the aesthetic of having a TV that was very unobtrusive, and the near-flush mounting plus available decorative frames do that. 

However, as someone looking for a "professional" TV install, this TV's lack of hardwire connection between display and connection box is very disappointing. Previous The Frame TV's had at least a connection kit available separately, this one does not. Which also means "hiding the box" is very limited, and EMI will be an issue, especially with higher resolution and framerate video. 

We also are not pleased that our 4K (and above) photos cannot be displayed edge-to-edge - you must have a mat - yet the subscription Art does not require the mat.
